title: Hillenkoetter frustrated at being kept in the dark about Roswell
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hillenkoetter frustrated at being kept in the dark about Roswell, about 1947-1960s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it's so interesting because I think he was frustrated at not getting the proper information about Roswell.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he thinks Roscoe Hillenkoetter, a former head of the CIA (the US spy agency), was frustrated that he never got the full story about Roswell. Roswell is the town in New Mexico where, by many accounts, something crashed in 1947 and was recovered by the military. Michels brings this up alongside Donald Keyhoe, a writer and UFO campaigner, and the point is that if even a spy chief was kept in the dark, the secret was held very tightly.
